The PR uses `@[to_dual (attr := simp) ...]` for every other pair of simp-tagged siblings it re-attributes (`Iic_disjoint_Ioi`, `Iio_disjoint_Ici`, `Ici_disjoint_Iic`, `iUnion_Iic`, `iUnion_Iio`, `iUnion_Icc_right`, `iUnion_Ioc_right`, `iUnion_Ico_right`, `iUnion_Ioo_right`), so this pair is the odd one out.
